title: Fix #262: MCP stdio loop blocked by sync tools and unbounded change discovery
description:
GitHub issue #262, open since April 2026, reported on Windows: CLI fast, MCP times out (-32001). A reporter said in July they were uninstalling over it.

Four causes, diagnosed on the issue 2026-09-16:
1. get_minimal_context_tool, get_impact_radius_tool, get_review_context_tool, get_affected_flows_tool, query_graph_tool and semantic_search_nodes_tool are plain sync def in main.py, so a slow call blocks the whole stdio event loop and the client sees a hard timeout instead of a slow answer.
2. Change discovery with no changed_files is a serial chain of git subprocesses, each with its own 30s CRG_GIT_TIMEOUT budget. Four or five of those is the 120s client ceiling.
3. The discovery fallback runs git status --untracked-files=all, which stats the whole working tree.
4. A timed-out git diff returns an empty list, indistinguishable from 'no changes', which is what routes into the expensive fallback. NOT ours: issue #913, contributor PR #922 is open for it.

Fixing 1, 2 and 3 on branch fix/262-mcp-blocking. Supersedes crg-966, which asked for the same CRG_TOOL_TIMEOUT wrapper on a narrower set of tools.

Windows confirmation still outstanding and tracked separately by crg-229.

title: PR-comment workflow reports a red run when it correctly declines a stale head
description:
Run 35366168213 on staging failed with:

    PR head does not match the analyzed commit; refusing to comment.

That guard is right. The pull request moved between the analysis run and the comment step, so commenting would attach a report to a commit it did not analyse. Refusing is correct behaviour.

Exiting 1 is not. It paints a red run for an expected race, and it fires every time a branch is updated while its analysis is in flight, which happened 18 times today when the behind branches were brought up to date. A red run that means 'nothing was wrong' trains people to ignore red runs.

Should exit 0 with a ::notice saying which commit was analysed and which is now the head. Reserve the non-zero exit for a genuine failure to comment.
